entries.baseline_binding: prefix_bytes and prefix_sha256 MUST equal the EXPERIMENT_REGISTRY.md entry of historical_evidence_baseline_post_n14.json, the immutable 2026-09-24 whole-file digest. This is the anti-laundering check: it proves the frozen prefix is the originally audited content and not a re-freeze of whatever the registry happens to contain today.

purpose: EXPERIMENT_REGISTRY.md is an append-only live document, so pinning it by whole-file SHA-256 makes this read-only audit fail every time a new experiment is registered. The obvious remedy - refreshing the baseline to match the new file - would silently destroy the control. This lock pins the HISTORICAL PREFIX instead: any edit, reordering, deletion, or prepending inside the audited region still fails closed, while legitimate appends are permitted, measured, and reported.
